row.evidence: Whereby Meetings pricing lists Free, Pro ($10.99/mo, individual) and Business ($13.99/host/mo, min 3 hosts) with no SSO or SCIM; team members are invited and removed by hand in the dashboard, and the only 'Single Sign On' is Gmail/Apple sign-in.
row.notes: New row. No SAML/OIDC SSO or SCIM found on any tier of Whereby Meetings (pricing page, 87 support-centre articles, developer docs index). Team plan is Business because Pro is single-host only; $11.66 is the annual $139.90/host/yr from the pricing page's Annual toggle (monthly $13.99), min 3 hosts. 'Single Sign On' in the help centre means Gmail/Apple social sign-in, which does not count. Whereby Embedded (usage-priced video API, Build $9.99/mo + usage, Enterprise custom) has a REST API for rooms, meetings, recordings, transcriptions, summaries and insights, but no user-management endpoints. Not in the Okta Integration Network (404) or Entra gallery tutorials (404).

rate_limits.text: Embedded REST API (rooms etc., not users): Enterprise 1000 points/min, Build 100 points/min.

user_api.notes: The only public API is the Whereby Embedded REST API, whose endpoint list is /meetings, /insights, /recordings, /transcriptions, /summaries and /rooms; no user or team endpoints.

jumpcloud.notes: No 'Integrate with Whereby' page in JumpCloud's integration guide list; direct URL returned 403.

fallbacks.notes: Members are invited by email (comma-separated) and removed manually from the Team dashboard; no CSV import documented. Sign-in options are email code or Gmail/Apple social sign-in.
